newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea frees 788 prisoners in Christmas amnesty.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea frees 788 prisoners in Christmas amnesty.

text.p: South Korea freed 788 prisoners and juvenile delinquents on Tuesday in a Christmas amnesty, the Justice Ministry said in a statement.
It said they included 32 prisoners serving jail terms of 10 years or longer and 428 juveniles.
Those sentenced for organised crime, drug use or rape were excluded from the amnesty, the statement said.
